answer: I would gate daily listing on each ID relaying 1 GB of assigned, disjoint encrypted trellis imagery from a grove to a mapping kernel. Receivers meter ingress, verify batch hashes and sign ID/day/batch byte receipts; validators check assignments, signatures, counts and nonreuse. Failure denies listing. Shared links and parallel sends save overhead, not bytes: ten IDs need 10 GB/day. Network fees/power recur; routers are reusable capital; no stake. Spare capacity lowers cash cost. Receiver collusion can fake delivery; this meters traffic, not owners.
